Pakistan Deputy PM's Relative Arrested in Gangrape Case

A relative of Pakistan's Deputy Prime Minister Ishaq Dar has been arrested in connection with the alleged gangrape of two foreign women. The suspect, identified as Raza Dar, is reportedly the grandson of the Deputy PM. The incident has drawn attention to the politician due to the familial link.
